newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka closes firmer on dollar supply.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka closes firmer on dollar supply.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka made a strong gain at the close of a dull interbank session on Sunday on dollar selling by a leading foreign bank, dealers said.
The taka closed at 44.1700/1800 per dollar after opening at 44.1980/2080 against a previous close at 44.2000.
"There were very few transactions. Initial deals were mostly at around 44.2000, but taka made a heavy gain at the end by some late-hour (dollar) selling by a major foreign bank," said one dealer.
Call money was traded at between 7.5 and 8.0 percent against the previous 8.5-9.5 percent.
